cards.title: Publish Zooza to your website
intro: Your programmes are automatically available through simple booking and profile links generated by Zooza. But you can take it further—customize your widgets to match your business and brand!
Don’t forget: Update the new URL in widget settings.

cards.title: www.playfulmotion.co.uk (beefa84de7) › Widgets
intro: You can choose the basic integration via the WordPress plugin, which will cover most of the basic needs for many businesses. Alternatively, you can embed and customize widgets yourself. If that’s not enough, you can develop your own solution using our API. For assistance, check out the developer documentation on our website or contact us.
It is used to enrol clients to your programmes.
Shows all your programmes/classes in a coherent calendar view.
It is used for the client to review and manage the programmes, sessions and products they have ordered from your company.
It is used to display videos attached in programmes for enrolled clients.

It is used to sell products and services (t-shirts, videos, e-books, accommodation, insurance) to your clients. You can then link the sale of products and services to the booking form and client profile.
